summary: BGM Group Ltd. files a Form 6-K reporting it has regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing its delinquent 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F on July 21, 2026. No special-situation event. The filing is a routine regulatory update curing a prior non-compliance, with no acquisition, divestiture, activist activity, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action. The only action is the company's remediation of a periodic filing deficiency.
